step1_analysis.description: A replica bias circuit or delay cell used for adaptive power-supply regulation. It generates bias voltages based on control inputs to regulate the supply of serial links.

paper_reference.title: Adaptive Supply Serial Links With Sub-1-V Operation and Per-Pin Clock Recovery

power.description: Total DC power consumption of the bias circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: I_total ≈ I_XM1 + I_XM8. XM1 and XM8 are strongly ON (Vsg=1.8V). I_XM1 ≈ 450uA, I_XM8 ≈ 150uA. Total current ≈ 600uA. Power = 1.8V * 600uA = 1.08mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the saturation and linear region currents of the PMOS devices with W/L=5/0.5 in SKY130.

sky130_expected.calculation: XM8 acts as a pull-up resistor (Vsg=1.8V). XM9 and XM2 act as pull-down loads (Vsg = V_N0 - 0.9V). Equating currents places V_N0 around 1.7V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: XM8 is strongly driven with G=GND, pulling N0 close to the V_PRIME supply (1.8V).

sky130_expected.calculation: XM1 pulls up (Vsg=1.8V). XM7 (Vgs=0.9V) and XM10 (Vsg=V_N2) pull down. Equating currents: 690u*(1.8-V_N2) ≈ 310u + 250u*(V_N2-0.42)^2. Solving yields V_N2 ≈ 1.15V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Voltage divider formed by strong PMOS pull-up and moderate NMOS/PMOS pull-downs.

sensitivity_n0.description: Sensitivity of N0 voltage to VCTRL (dV_N0 / dVCTRL)

sky130_expected.calculation: As VCTRL increases, Vsg of XM9 decreases. To maintain current balance with XM8, V_N0 must increase by a similar amount. Sensitivity ≈ +0.8 to +1.0 V/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Source-follower-like behavior of XM9 with respect to VCTRL.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC operating point, power consumption, and DC transfer characteristics (sensitivity) of the bias circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Adaptive Supply Bias Circuit
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM1 N2 GND V VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 GND N4 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 V_PRIME DN V_PRIME GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 GND N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 V_PRIME GND V_PRIME GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM10 GND GND N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM7 N2 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 GND V_PRIME VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 GND VCTRL N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM6 GND VDD N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VV V 0 1.8
VV_PRIME V_PRIME 0 1.8
VVCTRL VCTRL 0 0.9
VDN DN 0 0.9
VN3 N3 0 0.9
VN4 N4 0 0.9

.control
op
let total_power = (-i(VVDD) - i(VV) - i(VV_PRIME)) * 1.8
print total_power
print v(N0) v(N2)

dc VVCTRL 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc v_n0_1 find v(N0) at=0.8
meas dc v_n0_2 find v(N0) at=1.0
let sensitivity_n0 = (v_n0_2 - v_n0_1) / 0.2
print sensitivity_n0
quit
.endc
